page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m1.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per vCPU.

This server type does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory, this instance is structured for workloads that require dedicated CPU resources but have minimal memory footprints. This hardware profile offers a cost-efficient option for lightweight compute-bound tasks, basic web serving, or distributed microservices where high memory capacity is not required.
